description: Kenvue Inc.'s purpose is to realize the extraordinary power of everyday care, and as a global leader at the intersection of healthcare and consumer goods it is the world's largest pure-play consumer health company by revenue, with $15.1 billion in net sales in the fiscal year 2025, combining the power of science with meaningful consumer insights and a digital strategy to empower consumers to live healthier lives. Built on more than a century of heritage and trusted by generations, its differentiated portfolio of iconic brands including Aveeno, BAND-AID Brand, Johnson's, Listerine, Neutrogena, Nicorette, Tylenol and Zyrtec is backed by science and recommended by healthcare professionals. Its portfolio includes Self Care, Skin Health and Beauty, and Essential Health products, connecting with consumers across North America, Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East and Africa, and Latin America, and it reports those three business segments.
